subject.title: Bug: OpenClaw 2026.4.9 exposes agent internal thinking (English) to user

question: Should maintainers approve a narrow core sanitizer fix for attribute-bearing reasoning tags on the embedded streaming delivery path?
rationale: The code change looks narrow, but the issue is sensitive internal-reasoning exposure and already carries no-new-fix-pr and security-review labels, so automation should not stage the fix without human security ownership.

options.title: Approve narrow sanitizer fix
options.body: Update the streaming scanner and open/close helpers to accept the same tag attributes/prefixes as the shared sanitizer, with split-chunk regression tests before closing.

options.title: Defer to broad delivery work
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader channel-leak work only if maintainers want one delivery-layer fix to cover all reasoning and inter-tool leakage surfaces.

options.title: Close after a merged canonical fix
options.body: Close only after a merged PR proves this exact streaming attribute case or a canonical issue explicitly owns it.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow sanitizer fix
recommendation.body: Update the streaming scanner and open/close helpers to accept the same tag attributes/prefixes as the shared sanitizer, with split-chunk regression tests before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the central reasoning-tag handling and block-streaming leakage work.
